results.content: TOKYO, Aug 12 (Reuters) – Japanese business confidence improved in August as manufacturers benefited from robust semiconductor demand while non-manufacturers were supported by strong domestic ​consumption, the latest Reuters Tankan survey showed. The monthly ‌poll, a leading indicator of the Bank of Japan’s quarterly Tankan business survey, showed the manufacturers’ sentiment index rose to plus 18 in August from plus 13 in July, marking the highest ‌level ​since March 2026. Non-manufacturers’ confidence climbed ⁠to plus 28 from ⁠plus 25.
